result.notes:
Defect 1 -- "test_suspended_stock_day_is_nan_on_every_leaf_reader is vacuous for 2 of the 3 readers": CONFIRMED, FIXED.

Reproduced without editing the source, via two instrumented CubeEngine subclasses on a locally rebuilt copy of the daily_view fixture (/Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/wp4fix/repro1.py). The test's three roots stay green under BOTH mutants, each proven to have fired:
  - cube mutant (_load_leaf_cube's DailyFeature branch returns the bare tensor): test-as-written passes = [True, True, True]; cross_mean(FloatCap, 3) moves by max|diff| 1.000e6 over 50 cells.
  - panel mutant (operand() returns the unmasked (D, S) plane): test passes = [True, True, True]; cs_demean(FloatCap) moves by max|diff| 1.071e9 over 347 cells and cs_rank(FloatCap) by 0.1999 over 262 cells, with the NaN pattern IDENTICAL in both cases.
The review's two explanations also check out directly: Ret is NaN wherever not tradable (asserted: np.all(np.isnan(ret[~trad])) is True), which is why day_mean(mul(Ret, LimitWidth)) is NaN-shadowed; and _run_panel_round re-masks every node output unconditionally (engine.py:403-408), which is why the pattern cannot move. My per-expression mutant-fire counts are 1 each rather than the review's full-suite 45 / 21 -- same mutants, narrower carrier set.

Fix: four new tests, two per reader.
  - test_cube_leaf_mask_carries_into_cross_mean_values -- cross_mean(FloatCap, 3) (MODE_S round, the daily leaf its only operand, so nothing else can supply a NaN) against a hand-written causal 3-day rolling nanmean over np.where(view.tradable(), cap, nan). Agrees to 1.13e-7 relative; asserted at rtol 1e-6.
  - test_panel_leaf_operand_mask_carries_into_cs_demean_values -- cs_demean(FloatCap) against cap_masked - nanmean(cap_masked, axis=cross-section), asserting the finite VALUES. Agrees to 8.08e-8 of the plane's own scale. Tolerance is scaled by max|cap| rather than per-cell relative, because demeaned values straddle zero (FloatCap is ~1e9-1e10, so a per-cell rtol would be meaningless near the mean).
  - test_dropping_the_cube_leaf_mask_changes_cross_mean -- neutralises ONLY the _mask_cube call made from inside _load_leaf_cube (restored in a finally), asserts the carrier moves, and asserts the NaN pattern does NOT, so the reason an np.isnan-only assertion is blind here is itself pinned.
  - test_dropping_the_panel_operand_mask_changes_cs_demean -- pre-seeds self._daily_t with the unmasked plane, so operand()'s DailyFeature branch returns before it would apply tradable_ds. If _daily_t is ever removed this raises AttributeError (fails loudly) rather than silently stopping to fire.
Mutation-verified by re-applying each mutant to engine.py itself: cube mutant -> 2 failed / 29 passed (the two cross_mean tests), panel mutant -> 2 failed / 29 passed (the two cs_demean tests), no other test in the file notices either. engine.py restored byte-identically after each (diff confirmed empty).

Defect 2 -- "_leaf_panel is called outside evaluate()'s per-root error handling": CONFIRMED, FIXED.

Reproduced exactly as described on a fresh synthetic store with no daily source attached (repro2.py). Control, tolerant=True: [cs_rank(FloatCap), cs_rank(day_mean(Close))] -> errors == {0: "cs_rank: ValueError: dailyfields.resolve: 'FloatCap' needs a daily store carrying it (daily_root)"}, root 1 fine. Bare leaf: [DailyFeature("FloatCap"), cs_rank(day_mean(Close))] -> ValueError escapes evaluate() and the healthy root's panel is lost with it.

Fix applied as suggested at engine.py:193 -- try/except around self._leaf_panel(node.expr), re-raise when not tolerant, else errors[i] = f"{node.key}: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}" and continue. After the fix the same call returns errors == {0: "DF:FloatCap: ValueError: dailyfields.resolve: ..."} with panels[0] None and panels[1] intact.
I checked the blast radius of adding error entries where an exception used to escape: every consumer of EvalResult.errors treats the value as an opaque string (research.py:129-130, calculate.py:145-146, scripts/eval_legacy_factors.py:168, scripts/validate_gpu_parity.py:192, scripts/diagnose_run.py:144, scripts/legacy_acceptance.py:61), so no caller's parsing changes.
Two tests: test_unresolvable_bare_daily_root_does_not_sink_a_tolerant_batch (the two-root batch returns the healthy (D, S) panel with finite values and records exactly one error, keyed to index 0 and naming DF:FloatCap and daily_root) and test_unresolvable_bare_daily_root_still_raises_when_not_tolerant. Reverting the fix turns the first one red (verified, 1 failed / 30 passed); the second passes either way by design, as a guard that the fix does not swallow errors in strict mode.
